name: c-message-1
title: Two-sided conversation
label: Two-Sided Chat
description: Incoming and outgoing rows separated by nothing but the align prop.

guidance.bestFor: The bare pattern with no avatars or metadata, where a muted or default bubble repeats which side spoke

whenNotToUse.when: Several turns in a row from one person that should share one avatar

name: c-message-2
title: Avatars on both sides
label: Avatars
description: Bottom-anchored avatars that flip with the row, plus a presence dot.

guidance.bestFor: Photo avatars for both people, a green presence badge with a screen reader Online label and a long turn that wraps
agentNotes: `MICHAEL_AVATAR` and `SARAH_AVATAR` are Unsplash demo portraits; swap them for your users' avatar URLs
Badged rows set `overflow-visible` on `MessageAvatar`, since its round clip cuts the `AvatarBadge` in half

whenNotToUse.when: A run of turns from one sender where only the last row carries a portrait

name: c-message-3
title: Sender name and delivery status
label: Sender & Status
description: Header for identity, footer for status, and how each one picks its side.

guidance.bestFor: A name and time header split by a decorative dot, a Read receipt under the outgoing turn and an Edited footer
agentNotes: Each time and the Read receipt in `MessageHeader` and `MessageFooter` are hardcoded strings; render them from your message timestamps
On an `align` end row `MessageHeader` moves to the end with the bubble; the demo only puts headers on start rows

whenNotToUse.when: A footer holding icon buttons that act on the reply

name: c-message-4
title: Reply actions in the footer
label: Reply Actions
description: Copy, regenerate and rating controls under an unframed assistant reply.

guidance.bestFor: Regenerate cycling 2 stored drafts and clearing the vote, a Copy that flips to a check, and pressed thumb toggles
agentNotes: `DRAFTS` holds 2 canned answers and Regenerate only steps `draftIndex` through them; call your model there
`vote` lives in local state and is never sent; post the rating from the thumb `onClick` handlers

whenNotToUse.when: A reply that shows a thinking line and then types itself out

name: c-message-5
title: Files shared in a thread
label: Shared Files
description: Image and document attachments stacked with the bubble in one message.

guidance.bestFor: An outgoing image tile above its caption and an incoming CSV card under its text, with a named download button
agentNotes: `HERO_ARTWORK` and the file names and sizes are demo values; fill them from each uploaded file's URL, name and size
The download `AttachmentAction` has no click handler, so wire it to your file download

whenNotToUse.when: A tray of removable file chips in the composer before anything is sent

name: c-message-6
title: Consecutive messages from one sender
label: Consecutive Messages
description: A run of three messages under a single avatar, using MessageGroup.

guidance.bestFor: The name on the first row and the portrait on the last, with empty avatar slots holding the run on one spine
agentNotes: Keep the empty `MessageAvatar` on the earlier rows of a run; removing it shifts them off the column the portrait sits on
Wrap each run in `MessageGroup` and give `MessageHeader` to its first row and the `Avatar` to its last when mapping your messages

whenNotToUse.when: Each turn carrying its own portrait, with a presence badge on the sender

name: c-message-7
title: Streaming reply with a pending state
label: Streaming Reply
description: One assistant row moving from thinking, to typing, to settled.

guidance.bestFor: A spinner line, then text revealed 4 characters at a time behind a caret, and the full answer at once under reduced motion
agentNotes: The reveal is a timer over the fixed `ANSWER` string; set `revealed` or the text from your token stream
Keep the `role` status span mounted in both states, since a live region inserted together with its text is not announced

whenNotToUse.when: A settled answer that needs copy, regenerate and rating buttons under it
A streaming reply in a long thread that has to keep the newest text in view
